_written: 2026-10-10, BEFORE any HTF signal or return was computed. Track A (HTF liquidity levels), generation 19.
bars: 1-hour OHLC. Signals use a bar only after it has closed; entry at the NEXT bar's open.
trading_day: futures/CFD/FX: day starts 17:00 America/New_York (key = date of ts_ET + 7h); crypto: UTC calendar day. Week = ISO week of the trading-day date.

levels.PD: previous trading day high/low (completed day only; available from the first bar of the next trading day; expires at the end of that day)
levels.PW: previous trading week high/low (completed week only; active for the whole current week)

scale: ATRd = 20-day mean of daily true range from COMPLETED trading days (shifted one day)
event_rule: per level and side, only the FIRST bar that trades through the level in its active period defines the event (no re-use of a level). Minimum penetration delta = 0.05 * ATRd beyond the level.

strategies.A1_SR1: sweep and reclaim in one bar: high > L + delta and close < L (short at prior high); mirror at prior low (long). Stop = bar extreme +/- 0.05*ATRd.
strategies.A3_SR3: failed breakout: first through-bar closes beyond L; a close back inside L within the next 3 bars triggers the reversal trade. Stop = extreme since the cross +/- 0.05*ATRd.
strategies.A2_BO: breakout continuation: first through-bar closes beyond L + delta; trade in the break direction. Stop = entry -/+ 0.5*ATRd.

exits_primary: stop (conservative: if the bar range touches the stop, fill at the worse of stop and the bar open; stop is assumed hit BEFORE any favourable move inside the same bar) or time exit at the open 6 bars after entry
exit_neighbours: time exit 3 and 12 bars; 1.5R target + stop + 12-bar time exit (target only if bar opens/trades through it AFTER the stop check)
position: one open trade per strategy x instrument x level family; new signals ignored while in a trade. Risk-normalised: every trade risks 1R = |entry - stop|; P&L reported in R and as daily R-sum.

costs_round_trip.cme_futures: Instrument.cost_per_rt (commission + 1 tick slippage per side) / point_value
costs_round_trip.btc: 14 bp of price (taker 4 bp + 3 bp slippage per side)

DUKASCOPY_H1 (13 instruments: US500 US10.note: TEST years were previously observed by OTHER intraday hypotheses (v1/v3); labelled partially contaminated

BITSTAMP_BTC_1H.note: price path previously observed through daily CT1 research; intraday HTF never tested

TOPSTEPX_1H (ES NQ RTY GC CL 6E 6B 6J).note: GC/CL/6E/6B/6J never used by any strategy; ES/NQ/RTY used only by the v3 H3 holdout. Single look, only for strategies that pass DEV+VAL on Dukascopy

metric: primary = net Sharpe of the pooled daily R-sum series (all trading days incl. zero days, sqrt(252) for Dukascopy/futures, sqrt(365) for BTC), equal risk per trade; also expectancy in R, profit factor, win rate

gates.DEV: pooled net Sharpe >= 0.5 AND net expectancy > 0 AND >= 60% of instruments with positive net expectancy
gates.VAL: pooled net Sharpe >= 0.3 AND net expectancy > 0
gates.TEST: single look: net Sharpe > 0 at 1x AND >= 0 at 2x costs
gates.FRESH_HOLDOUT: single look: net expectancy > 0 at 1x costs

directions: long and short reported separately; the gate applies to the combined strategy
multiple_testing: 6 primaries (3 strategies x 2 level families) per dataset; Holm across primaries on DEV Newey-West p-values reported
